name: PandaApps
description: Native Android companion apps for Minima — eurobuddha's apps plus the official Minima app.
disclaimer: Every app here is free, open source, and yours to use, fork, share or make your own — every repo is public, so please read the code and do your own due diligence. They're built in the open and still in active development, provided as is with no warranty. They talk to a live blockchain and real funds, so back up your seed, start with small amounts, and use at your own risk. Nothing here is financial advice.

apps.name: PandaApps
apps.description: v0.4.5: compatible with Minima Core PandaBear, BlackBear and Pandamonium in the eurobuddha namespace. v0.4.2: the stores lead the list. PandaApps and PandaGet now sit at the top of the front page under GET STARTED, ahead of the Minima Core builds, instead of at the bottom under MORE. First release since 0.3.0; no other changes to how PandaApps works. v0.3.0: fewer scary warnings. The store no longer asks Android for the right to see every app on your phone — that permission, next to the one that lets it install, is what made Google Play Protect flag it as harmful. It also now tells you BEFORE downloading when an app cannot be updated in place because your copy was signed with our old key, and offers to uninstall it, instead of failing at the end with a bare "App not installed". NEW SIGNING KEY: uninstall the old version before installing this one (Android refuses an in-place update when the signature changes; Minima apps must re-pair MINIMA_ID with the node afterwards). v0.2.9: fix — after installing anything, its row kept saying "Waiting for the installer…" instead of showing that it had installed; the row pinned under Updates also stopped showing download progress, and an app's page jumped back to the top repeatedly while downloading. v0.2.8: a new front page — apps are grouped by what they do (Wallets, Finance & Trading, Tools, Social, Games and the rest), anything out of date is pinned to an Updates section at the top, and each row is now just an icon, a name and its state instead of a wall of text. Tap any app for its own page: full description, version history, install actions, and a link straight to its source code — every app in this store is open source, and every catalog entry now carries its repo. v0.2.6: housekeeping — Android's automatic backup is switched off for this app. It only caches downloaded APKs, but the shared node-pairing token was being copied to your phone/cloud backup; a reinstall should always be a clean start. Note: switching backup off cannot delete a backup that already exists, so if this app misbehaves right after a reinstall, clear its app storage (App info → Storage → Clear storage).

apps.name: PandaGet
apps.description: v0.4.5: compatible with Minima Core PandaBear, BlackBear and Pandamonium in the eurobuddha namespace. v0.4.2: the stores lead the list. PandaApps and PandaGet now sit at the top of the front page under GET STARTED, ahead of the Minima Core builds, instead of at the bottom under MORE. v0.4.1: its own icon. PandaGet no longer wears PandaApps' launcher icon — it now shows the stitched cartoon panda, so the two are distinguishable side by side. No functional changes. v0.4.0: first release. PandaApps without the install permission, for anyone whose phone blocks PandaApps as a harmful app. Google Play Protect distrusts a sideloaded store that can install apps; PandaGet cannot install anything, so there is nothing for it to object to. It shows the same catalog, and Download saves an app's APK, verified against its published SHA-256, into your Downloads folder. Open the file from your Files app to install it yourself: Android asks you once to allow installs from your file manager, and every app still confirms in the system installer. Play Protect may still warn about a downloaded app itself while our new signing key earns its reputation, but from the Files app you get the normal choice to install anyway, instead of the store being blocked outright. Requires Android 10 or newer.

apps.name: Terminal IDE
apps.description: v0.3.2: compatible with Minima Core PandaBear, BlackBear and Pandamonium in the eurobuddha namespace. v0.3.1: complete help for every node command. The node's own help leaves things out (vault never mentions password:, confirm:, numkeys: or the testphrase/resetkeys actions; peers omits url:; sendfrom, createfrom, signfrom, txnauto and others have no page at all), and the app used to show the same gaps. Every parameter and action value the node accepts is now documented in the autocomplete dropdown, the help dialog and help command:x. v0.3.0: renumbered, same app. Version 0.2.4 could not install over 0.2.3 and, if you did get it on, kept offering itself as an update forever — its internal build number had gone backwards. 0.3.0 puts the numbering back in line (the number in brackets now matches the version), so this update installs cleanly and settles. Includes everything from 0.2.4. v0.2.4: IMPORTANT — script deploys no longer default to trackall. Identical script text gives everyone the same address, so trackall on a template or burn script filled your wallet with other people's locked coins; deploys now track only your own coins unless you opt in, with a plain-language warning. To clean an already-affected wallet, redeploy the same script with trackall off (newscript replaces the old registration). NEW SIGNING KEY: uninstall the old version before installing this one (Android refuses an in-place update when the signature changes; Minima apps must re-pair MINIMA_ID with the node afterwards). v0.2.2: SECURITY. Terminal IDE records every command you type, word for word — which in a Minima terminal can include seed phrases and vault passwords — and that history was being uploaded to your phone/cloud backup. Cloud backup is now off for this app. Your own saved scripts are the one exception: they still travel when you move to a new phone (device transfer), because there is no other way to export them. Note: switching backup off cannot delete a backup that already exists, so if this app misbehaves right after a reinstall, clear its app storage (App info → Storage → Clear storage).

apps.name: FutureCash
apps.description: v0.2.13: compatible with Minima Core PandaBear, BlackBear and Pandamonium in the eurobuddha namespace. NEW SIGNING KEY: uninstall the old version before installing this one (Android refuses an in-place update when the signature changes; Minima apps must re-pair MINIMA_ID with the node afterwards). v0.2.9 never abbreviates an address. Payment cards used to show a recipient as "0x123456...abcd", which cannot be pasted into a wallet, an explorer or a support ticket — the only thing an address is for. Cards now carry the full recipient address, the Collect screen no longer repeats it in shortened form above the full copyable one, and the empty-list screens print the full contract address. v0.2.7 split the tabs by maturity: the main Send page lists everything READY TO COLLECT, and the Future tab lists only what is still locked, soonest to unlock first. v0.2.4 fixed locked payments not showing up at all: if your node missed the one pairing reply the app waited for — common after restoring a node, reinstalling, or restarting Minima Core — FutureCash never asked the node for your coins, and showed an empty list with no error while the block number kept ticking, so real locked funds looked like no funds. They were always safe on-chain and still visible in the FutureCash MiniDapp. The app now keeps retrying until it finds the contract, recognises it however it was registered, and also scans the canonical FutureCash address so a locally-derived address can never hide a stake. An empty list now says why, and the About tab shows the contract address in use so you can compare it with the MiniDapp's.

apps.name: FutureCash Next
apps.description: v0.1.8: compatible with Minima Core PandaBear, BlackBear and Pandamonium in the eurobuddha namespace. v0.1.7 never abbreviates an address: every screen and toast shows the full value, tap to copy. v0.1.6 says plainly when auto-collect is off — the guardian only auto-collects clean matured stakes once you opt in, and the status card, safe card and notification now all say so instead of rendering ‘Protected’ over waiting stakes. The WOTS-protected sibling of FutureCash: an unattended guardian for time-locked payments. A collect is pinned by the covenant and always safe in itself — the danger is where the funds land: a payout address whose one-time Winternitz key was reused leaks its secret. So the guardian audits every payout address first, then on every block: a clean address is collected (once you opt in); a reused, at-risk address is collected and immediately swept to your safe rescue destination, then verified arrived; an address the audit can't judge yet is left alone, because an uncollected coin sitting in the covenant is not at risk at all. Also on board: Harden (retire reused change addresses) and Recover (free coins stranded on retired ones). Runs as a foreground service with a single resumable spend state machine; every transaction path cleans up after itself, and only public keys and addresses ever leave the device. Installs alongside classic FutureCash — both share the same covenant address and interoperate with the FutureCash MiniDapp.

apps.name: AtomiX
apps.description: v0.1.82: validates maker funding and market/OTC input, retains signed Ethereum transactions across restarts and uncertain replies, protects reviewed send context, and improves OTC/responder recovery and interrupted-write acknowledgement. Includes 0.1.73–0.1.82 fixes. v0.1.72: compatible with Minima Core PandaBear, BlackBear and Pandamonium in the eurobuddha namespace. 0.1.71: supports PandaBear and BlackBear through a node-pinning SDK; refuses ambiguous two-node discovery. Fixes contract timestamp decoding on Android 9–11 while retaining exact overflow checks. Complete active swaps before changing wallet modes, then establish a valid destination-wallet identity. The same seed creates different addresses across modes. Native atomic swaps between Minima assets and Ethereum USDT. 0.1.70 locks in exact price arithmetic on the maker's accept checks: a swap offered at exactly your published price is now provably accepted (its MiniDapp and Desktop siblings silently ignored such swaps due to a rounding quirk, leaving the other side to wait out a refund — this app was unaffected and now carries the test that keeps it that way).

apps.name: Minima ETH Wallet
apps.description: v0.2.11: preserves imported keys when secure storage is unavailable; protects account and asset selection, validates RPC/key/nonce replies, and retains signed Ethereum transactions across restarts and uncertain sends. Includes 0.2.7–0.2.11 fixes. v0.2.6: compatible with Minima Core PandaBear, BlackBear and Pandamonium in the eurobuddha namespace. v0.2.5: Fix text and hint contrast in Send and other native dialogs in light and dark mode. Include the R8 configuration used by the validated release. NEW SIGNING KEY: uninstall the old version before installing this one (Android refuses an in-place update when the signature changes; Minima apps must re-pair MINIMA_ID with the node afterwards). Standalone Ethereum/ERC20 wallet sharing minimaSwap's address — manage tokens, send/receive (QR), add any ERC20 by contract address, live gas preview, view activity on Etherscan. Same address via node-pair or one-time key import. 0.2.2 is a security and stability release, recommended for everyone. Fixes a crash-loop on launch: reinstalling restored the encrypted key store from backup, but the Keystore key that unlocks it is device-bound and is not restored, so the app died on every start — backup of that store is now disabled and an unreadable store is repaired instead of fatal. The confirm screen now shows the FULL recipient address instead of a shortened one, so address-poisoning (a lookalike address matching the first and last few characters) can no longer hide there, and recipients are checksum-verified. Node-derived keys are validated and the address is pinned: if your node ever derives a DIFFERENT address — a reset or restored-with-another-seed node — the wallet stops and tells you your funds are at the old address, instead of silently showing you an empty new wallet. Gas price and limit from the RPC are now bounded, so a bad endpoint cannot drain the balance as fees.

apps.name: KeyUses
apps.description: v0.1.4: recognises the new block-as-keyuses keys (128/4, minimaCore started with -blockaskeyuses) alongside classic 64/3 keys. Same signing key as 0.1.3 — installs as a normal update. Audit your node's keys for one-time-signature re-use. Minima signatures are stateful: each key must move to a fresh leaf every time it signs, and a seed re-sync that set keyuses too low makes the node re-use a leaf it already spent on-chain, which weakens that key. KeyUses compares what the chain proves each key has signed against your node's own counter, flags any key at risk or with confirmed re-use, and gives you the safe keyuses value for your next re-sync (classic keys only — block-as-keyuses keys take their key uses from the block height automatically, so no keyuses value is needed). Read-only: it never builds a transaction. Your public keys are sent to the archive audit service to look up spend history — public keys cannot move funds, but they do reveal your addresses to that server.

apps.name: Brain Wallet
apps.description: NEW SIGNING KEY: uninstall the old version before installing this one (Android refuses an in-place update when the signature changes; Minima apps must re-pair MINIMA_ID with the node afterwards). Derive a Bitcoin, Litecoin or Ethereum wallet from a passphrase and salt — nothing is stored, nothing is transmitted, and the app asks for no permissions at all. Two derivation schemes. scrypt (N=2^18) reproduces legacy 1... addresses byte-for-byte with the Brain Wallet MiniDapp 1.0.14, so a wallet made there comes back identically here; this is the default. Argon2id (384MB, 25 iterations) produces native SegWit bc1q.../ltc1q... addresses and Ethereum, matching brainwallet.io v3.0.1 — verified against vectors generated from that site's own code, with a native ARM build of the reference Argon2 so it takes ~8 seconds instead of ~75. Address and private key shown as text and QR. ⚠️ A brain wallet has NO checksum and NO recovery: one wrong character silently derives a different, perfectly valid wallet that is not yours. Verify recovery on a second device before funding, and store the passphrase and salt as exact byte-for-byte artifacts.

Provably fair BIP39 seed phrase generator — roll animated dice for maximum entropy. Each face = SHA3(node random ++ device SecureRandom) rejection-sampled to exact uniformity; maths locked bit-for-bit to iancoleman/bip39 by fixed vectors. Physical-dice mode, per-roll audit log, Last Word checksum calculator with 4-char autocomplete. Zero permissions, FLAG_SECURE, nothing stored or transmitted — closing the app destroys the phrase.

apps.name: Minima Mail
apps.description: v0.5.11: persist the same Mail identity across reopen; failed backup imports preserve the previous identity and data. v0.5.11: compatible with Minima Core PandaBear, BlackBear and Pandamonium in the eurobuddha namespace. v0.5.8: photos taken in portrait are sent upright — they used to arrive rotated 90°. v0.5.7: a payment or message sent inside the previous one's confirmation window no longer fails with "Insufficient funds" until a node restart — the send pin asks the node only for coins it will actually spend. Keep native dialogs consistent with the selected Paper or Dark app theme. NEW SIGNING KEY: uninstall the old version before installing this one (Android refuses an in-place update when the signature changes; Minima apps must re-pair MINIMA_ID with the node afterwards). On-chain end-to-end encrypted mail — no server, no Maxima, no internet permission. Identity from your node seed; every message is a sealed blob in a tiny coin. v0.5.1: FUNDS/KEY SAFETY on top of the 0.5.0 email makeover. Every send (message coins and payments) is now pinned to a signable wallet coin, so anyone-can-spend beacon dust on a shared node can't be grabbed and fail the send after it has already burned a WOTS key-use. The pay-address auto-responder is hard rate-limited (hourly cap + per-peer cooldown) so forged requests can't drain coins or key-uses. And the pay-address validator now enforces the strict Mx charset plus a node-side checkaddress gate before any funds move — closing a crafted-address injection into the send command. 0.5.0 recap: full email UX — drawer folders (Inbox/Outbox/Sent/Archive), optional subject threading, To/Subject/Body compose, honest delivery status (Posting → On-chain block N → Confirmed, failures retryable from the Outbox), 'Checked block N' freshness line, light paper + dark themes, custom icons. Conversations keep their chat bubbles.
